agent_summary: Called Mr. Lim (66) regarding his ILP. While his wife was present and the language was appropriate (Mandarin), several red flags appeared: he did not receive the FNA, the agent didn't review existing coverage, he was unaware of fees, misstated the premium amount, and found the payment to be a stretch.
missell_assessment: There are significant concerns regarding the suitability and selling process for this ILP. The client (aged 66) indicated the premium was a stretch, did not know the premium amount accurately, was unaware of fees, and did not have their existing coverage reviewed by the agent. No FNA document was provided, and supervisor verification is pending.
